The absorption of nitrogen gas directly by plant roots

questions.explanation: Nitrogen fixation is the process of converting atmospheric nitrogen gas (N2) into usable nitrogen compounds such as ammonia. This is carried out by nitrogen-fixing bacteria, some of which live in root nodules of leguminous plants.
